optimized_sql:
WITH mv AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT i.i_item_id, ca.ca_country, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_county,
           avg(cast(cs.cs_quantity as decimal(12,2))) agg1,
           avg(cast(cs.cs_list_price as decimal(12,2))) agg2,
           avg(cast(cs.cs_coupon_amt as decimal(12,2))) agg3,
           avg(cast(cs.cs_sales_price as decimal(12,2))) agg4,
           avg(cast(cs.cs_net_profit as decimal(12,2))) agg5,
           avg(cast(c.c_birth_year as decimal(12,2))) agg6,
           avg(cast(cd1.cd_dep_count as decimal(12,2))) agg7
    FROM (
        SELECT d_date_sk
        FROM date_dim
        WHERE d_year = 2001
    ) AS d
    JOIN catalog_sales AS cs ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN (
        SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_dep_count
        FROM customer_demographics
        WHERE cd_gender = 'F' AND cd_education_status = 'Primary'
    ) AS cd1 ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN (
        SELECT c_customer_sk, c_current_cdemo_sk, c_current_addr_sk, c_birth_year
        FROM customer
        WHERE c_birth_month IN (1,3,7,11,10,4)
    ) AS c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
    JOIN (
        SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county
        FROM customer_address
        WHERE ca_state IN ('AL','MO','TN','GA','MT','IN','CA')
    ) AS ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics AS cd2 ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN item AS i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    GROUP BY ROLLUP (i.i_item_id, ca.ca_country, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_county)
)
SELECT i_item_id, ca_country, ca_state, ca_county,
       agg1, agg2, agg3, agg4, agg5, agg6, agg7
FROM mv
ORDER BY ca_country, ca_state, ca_county, i_item_id
LIMIT 100
